_source: Issue #36 sanitized debug log (home-assistant_tineco_2026-08-17_sanitized.log), Floor One S5 FW103000US, firmware CL2019Z-12, region CA (dc=na), integration v2.4.2, HA 2026.7.2.
_regression_note: The Floor One S5 gci payload carries no tank fields (no e1/e2/e3/wp) in any captured state, including with the fresh tank empty. The fresh-water sensor used to fall through to a hard-coded 'full' (and the waste sensor to 'clean'); both must report unknown (None) for this payload shape.
